description: Source code for the BalsaHeaders class, which manages HTTP headers including parsing, modification, and serialization within the quiche HTTP/3 implementation.

classes.name: BalsaHeaders
classes.description: Manages HTTP headers, supporting parsing, modification, and serialization.

classes.name: HeaderLineDescription
classes.description: Represents a single header line with positional information within the buffer.

classes.name: HeaderTokenList
classes.description: Type alias for a list of header tokens used in parsing header values.

methods.name: ParseTokenList
methods.description: Parses a header value into tokens separated by commas.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the header object to an empty state.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Copies header data from another BalsaHeaders instance.

methods.name: AddAndMakeDescription
methods.description: Adds a header key-value pair with description metadata.

methods.name: AppendAndMakeDescription
methods.description: Appends a value to an existing header line.

methods.name: MaybeClearSpecialHeaderValues
methods.description: Clears internal flags if a header key affects transfer encoding or content length.

methods.name: RemoveAllOfHeaderStartingAt
methods.description: Removes all header lines with a specific key starting from a given iterator.

methods.name: ReplaceOrAppendHeader
methods.description: Replaces an existing header or appends a new one.

methods.name: AppendHeader
methods.description: Appends a new header key-value pair.

methods.name: AppendToHeader
methods.description: Appends a value to an existing header line.

methods.name: AppendToHeaderWithCommaAndSpace
methods.description: Appends a value to a multivalued header, separated by comma and space.

methods.name: GetHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a header by key.

methods.name: SetContentLength
methods.description: Sets the Content-Length header and internal state.

methods.name: SetTransferEncodingToChunkedAndClearContentLength
methods.description: Sets transfer encoding to chunked and clears Content-Length.

methods.name: SetNoTransferEncoding
methods.description: Removes transfer encoding headers.

methods.name: ClearContentLength
methods.description: Removes the Content-Length header.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the header buffer is empty.

methods.name: Authority
methods.description: Returns the value of the Host header.

methods.name: ReplaceOrAppendAuthority
methods.description: Replaces or appends the Host header.

methods.name: RemoveAuthority
methods.description: Removes the Host header.

methods.name: ApplyToCookie
methods.description: Applies a function to the Cookie header value.

methods.name: SetResponseFirstline
methods.description: Sets the response status line with version, code, and reason phrase.

methods.name: SetFirstlineFromStringPieces
methods.description: Constructs the first line from individual string parts.

methods.name: SetRequestMethod
methods.description: Sets the HTTP request method in the request line.

methods.name: SetResponseVersion
methods.description: Sets the response version in the status line.

methods.name: SetRequestUri
methods.description: Sets the request URI in the request line.

methods.name: SetResponseCode
methods.description: Sets the response status code.

methods.name: SetParsedResponseCodeAndUpdateFirstline
methods.description: Sets the parsed response code and updates the status line.

methods.name: SetRequestVersion
methods.description: Sets the request version in the request line.

methods.name: SetResponseReasonPhrase
methods.description: Sets the reason phrase in the response status line.

methods.name: RemoveLastTokenFromHeaderValue
methods.description: Removes the last token from a header value.

methods.name: ResponseCanHaveBody
methods.description: Determines if a response code can have a body.
